# Store-sql-analysis
SQL analysis on store dataset to derive business trends and insights

##Business problem:
Analyze the Store dataset to identify high-performing products, customer segments, regional sales trends, and year-over-year growth to support better business decision-making.

##Key Findings:
-Furniture sub-categories with highest sales: Chairs, Tables, Bookcases, Furnishings
-Significant growth observed in Bookcases in 2015
-Consumer segment contributes the highest number of purchases
-California generates the highest sales among all states

##Tools used:
Postgre sql. Google colab. Tableau

##Files:
'/sql/'
[storequeries.sql](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26251407/storequeries.sql)
--List of furniture sub_categories with higher sales
select 
  sub_category, 
  count(*) as total_count,
  sum(quantity) as total_quantity,
  round(sum(sales):: numeric,2) as total_sales,
  round(avg(sales):: numeric,2) as avg_sales,
  round(sum(profit):: numeric,2) as sum_profit
from store_table
where category= 'Furniture'
group by sub_category
order by total_sales desc;

--yearly trend of furniture demand grown over the year
select
  extract(year from order_date) as year,
  sub_category,
  count(*) as orders,
  round(sum(sales)::numeric,2) as total_sales,
  lag(count(*)) over (partition by sub_category order by extract(year from order_date)) as previous_year_orders,
  
  round(
        (count(*) - lag(count(*)) over 
		(partition by sub_category 
		order by extract(year from order_date))) * 100.0 /
        nullif(lag(count(*)) over 
		(partition by sub_category 
		order by extract(year from order_date)
        ), 0),
        1)                  as growth_trend_percent
from store_table
where category ='Furniture'
group by Year, sub_category
order by sub_category, year;

--list of customer segment with higher purchase

select
  segment,
  count(distinct customer_id) as unique_customer,
  count(*) as total_order,
  round(sum(sales)::numeric, 2) as total_sales,
  round(avg(sales)::numeric,2) as avg_sales,
  round(sum(profit):: numeric, 2) as total_profit,
  round(avg(discount)::numeric,3) as avg_discount

from store_table
where category= 'Furniture'
group by segment
order by total_sales desc;

--region with higher furniture revenue

select
  region,
  state,
  count(*) as total_orders,
  round(sum(sales),2) as total_sales,
  round(sum(profit),2) as total_profit,
  round(sum(profit)*100.0/nullif(sum(sales),0),1) as profit_margin
  
from store_table
where category= 'Furniture'
group by region, state
order by total_sales desc
limit 10;

--top furniture buyers

select
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  segment,
  state,
  count(*) as total_orders,
  round(sum(sales),2) as total_sales,
  round(sum(profit),2) as total_profit,
  rank() over (order by sum(sales)desc) as revenue_rank

from store_table
where category='Furniture'
group by customer_id, customer_name, segment, state
order by total_sales desc
limit 10;

              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",

              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",

              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",

              "    li.append(span(\n",

              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",

              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",

        "# chart1 Revenue by sub-category\n",
        "rev_by_sub= furniture.groupby('Sub_Category')['Sales'].sum().sort_values()\n",
        "axes[0,0].barh(rev_by_sub.index, rev_by_sub.values, color='blue')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_title ('Revenue by Sub_Category')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Total sales($)')\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart2 Yearly revenue trend\n",
        "yearly= furniture.groupby('year')['Sales'].sum()\n",
        "axes[0,1].plot(yearly.index, yearly.values, marker='o', color= 'teal', linewidth=2)\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_title ('Revenue by trend')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Year')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Total sales($)')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_xticks(yearly.index)\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart3 Revenue by customer segment\n",
        "seg= furniture.groupby('Segment')['Sales'].sum()\n",
        "axes[1,0].pie(seg.values, labels= seg.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',\n",
        "              startangle=90, colors= ['#378ADD','#1D9E75','#EF9F27'])\n",
        "axes[1,0].set_title ('Revenue by customer segment')\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart4 profit vs discount scatter\n",
        "axes[1,1].scatter(furniture['Discount'], furniture['Profit'], alpha=0.3, color= 'green')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_title('Profit vs Discount Scatter')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Discount rate')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Profit($)')\n",
        "axes[1,1].axhline(y=0, color= 'red', linestyle='--', linewidth= 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('eda_charts.png' , dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Chart saved!\")\n"
      ],

        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "df= pd.read_csv ('Untitled spreadsheet - Book2 (1).csv', encoding= 'latin-1')\n",
        "\n",
        "print (\"total rows=\" ,df.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"total columns=\" ,df.columns.tolist())\n",
        "df.head()\n",
        "\n",
        "furniture= df[df['Category']=='Furniture'].copy()\n",
        "furniture ['Order_Date']= pd.to_datetime(furniture['Order_Date'])\n",
        "furniture['year']= furniture['Order_Date'].dt.year\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"furniture orders=\", furniture.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"\\nsub_categories=\\n\", furniture ['Sub_Category'].value_counts())\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,2, figsize= (14,9))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('Furniture Sales Analysis- Store Dataset', fontsize=14, y=1.01)\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart1 Revenue by sub-category\n",
        "rev_by_sub= furniture.groupby('Sub_Category')['Sales'].sum().sort_values()\n",
        "axes[0,0].barh(rev_by_sub.index, rev_by_sub.values, color='blue')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_title ('Revenue by Sub_Category')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Total sales($)')\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart2 Yearly revenue trend\n",
        "yearly= furniture.groupby('year')['Sales'].sum()\n",
        "axes[0,1].plot(yearly.index, yearly.values, marker='o', color= 'teal', linewidth=2)\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_title ('Revenue by trend')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Year')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Total sales($)')\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_xticks(yearly.index)\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart3 Revenue by customer segment\n",
        "seg= furniture.groupby('Segment')['Sales'].sum()\n",
        "axes[1,0].pie(seg.values, labels= seg.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',\n",
        "              startangle=90, colors= ['#378ADD','#1D9E75','#EF9F27'])\n",
        "axes[1,0].set_title ('Revenue by customer segment')\n",
        "\n",
        "# chart4 profit vs discount scatter\n",
        "axes[1,1].scatter(furniture['Discount'], furniture['Profit'], alpha=0.3, color= 'green')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_title('Profit vs Discount Scatter')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Discount rate')\n",
        "axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Profit($)')\n",
        "axes[1,1].axhline(y=0, color= 'red', linestyle='--', linewidth= 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('eda_charts.png' , dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Chart saved!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "files.download('eda_charts.png')\n"
